title.sl: Glagoli poročanja: suggested going, advised me to
title.de: Verben des Sagens: suggested going, advised me to
title.it: I verbi per riferire: suggested going, advised me to
title.en: Reporting verbs: suggested going, advised me to

rule.sl:
Namesto **said** povedo nekateri glagoli več, vsak s svojim vzorcem.

**to** + osnovna oblika: **promise, refuse, agree, offer**: **Jack promised to come.** **Old Wilf refused to pay.** Z ne: **He promised not to tell.**

Oseba + **to**: **advise, warn, remind, tell, ask**: **He advised me to wait.** **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.**

**-ing**: **suggest, admit, deny**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** **Harry admitted taking the cake.** **He denied taking the money.** Za preteklost tudi **having**: **He denied having taken it.**

Pri **suggest** ni osebe + to: **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*), ali **Sam suggested that we go by bus.**, **that we should go**. Slovenščina reče *predlagal mi je*.

**that** + stavek, s korakom nazaj: **admit, deny, promise, warn, agree**: **He admitted that he had taken it.** **She warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** lahko odpade.

Mala beseda + **-ing**: **apologise for, insist on, thank for, accuse of**: **She apologised for being late.** **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** **They accused him of taking the money.**
rule.de:
Statt **said** sagen manche Verben mehr, jedes mit seinem Muster.

**to** + Grundform: **promise, refuse, agree, offer**: **Jack promised to come.** **Old Wilf refused to pay.** Verneint: **He promised not to tell.**

Person + **to**: **advise, warn, remind, tell, ask**: **He advised me to wait.** **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.**

**-ing**: **suggest, admit, deny**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** **Harry admitted taking the cake.** **He denied taking the money.** Für die Vergangenheit auch **having**: **He denied having taken it.**

Bei **suggest** gibt es kein Person + to: **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*), oder **Sam suggested that we go by bus.**, **that we should go**. Deutsch sagt *er schlug mir vor*.

**that** + Satz, ein Schritt zurück: **admit, deny, promise, warn, agree**: **He admitted that he had taken it.** **She warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** kann wegfallen.

Kleines Wort + **-ing**: **apologise for, insist on, thank for, accuse of**: **She apologised for being late.** **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** **They accused him of taking the money.**
rule.it:
Invece di **said** alcuni verbi dicono di più, ognuno con il suo schema.

**to** + forma base: **promise, refuse, agree, offer**: **Jack promised to come.** **Old Wilf refused to pay.** Col no: **He promised not to tell.**

Persona + **to**: **advise, warn, remind, tell, ask**: **He advised me to wait.** **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.**

**-ing**: **suggest, admit, deny**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** **Harry admitted taking the cake.** **He denied taking the money.** Per il passato anche **having**: **He denied having taken it.**

Con **suggest** non c'è persona + to: **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*), o **Sam suggested that we go by bus.**, **that we should go**. L'italiano dice *mi ha suggerito di*.

**that** + frase, un passo indietro: **admit, deny, promise, warn, agree**: **He admitted that he had taken it.** **She warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** può cadere.

Parolina + **-ing**: **apologise for, insist on, thank for, accuse of**: **She apologised for being late.** **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** **They accused him of taking the money.**
rule.en:
In place of **said** some verbs say more, each with its pattern.

**to** + the base form: **promise, refuse, agree, offer**: **Jack promised to come.** **Old Wilf refused to pay.** With no: **He promised not to tell.**

Someone + **to**: **advise, warn, remind, tell, ask**: **He advised me to wait.** **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.**

**-ing**: **suggest, admit, deny**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** **Harry admitted taking the cake.** **He denied taking the money.** For the past **having** too: **He denied having taken it.**

**suggest** takes no someone + to: **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*), or **Sam suggested that we go by bus.**, **that we should go**.

**that** + a clause, one step back: **admit, deny, promise, warn, agree**: **He admitted that he had taken it.** **She warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** can go.

A small word + **-ing**: **apologise for, insist on, thank for, accuse of**: **She apologised for being late.** **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** **They accused him of taking the money.**

rows: Sam suggested that we go by bus.

rows.en: that + a clause, one step back
